title: Creek Kids Club Extended Day Program: How a Payment Plan's First Payment Is Taken
content:
The payment rule of a Creek Kids Club Extended Day Program payment plan decides how the first payment is taken from the open balance and the number of payments:

| Condition | First payment taken |
|---|---|
| the most recently posted billing month carries a late payment fee | that late payment fee in full, together with an equal share of the rest of the open balance (the open balance less that fee, divided by the number of payments) |
| that month carries no late payment fee and the open balance is less than 50.00 | the larger of 25.00 and an equal share of the open balance (the open balance divided by the number of payments) |
| otherwise | an equal share of the open balance |

The most recently posted billing month is the billing month of the latest tuition charge on the enrollment's billing history. A month carries a late payment fee when a late payment fee entry for that billing month is on the billing history.

## Worked cases (hypothetical figures)

| Open balance | Late payment fee on latest month | Number of payments | First payment |
|---|---|---|---|
| 263.00 | 11.00 | 3 | 11.00 plus a third of 252.00, which is 95.00 |
| 263.00 | none | 3 | a third of 263.00, which is 87.67 |
| 44.00 | none | 3 | the larger of 25.00 and 14.67, which is 25.00 |
| 44.00 | none | 1 | the larger of 25.00 and 44.00, which is 44.00 |
| 50.00 | none | 2 | an equal share, 25.00 |
